issues.detail: The Greek 'οουχ οπου ωνομασθη' (not where [He] was named) is rendered in Vietnamese as 'nơi nào danh Đấng Christ chưa được truyền ra' (where the name of Christ has not yet been preached). The Greek implies a location where the name was *not* established/named, whereas the Vietnamese phrasing 'chưa được truyền ra' (has not yet been preached) introduces a specific action of preaching that is not explicitly in the source text.

The Greek 'ουχ οπου ωνομασθη' uses a negative ('ουχ'). The Vietnamese translation uses 'chưa được' (not yet), which implies a future possibility or a pending action, whereas the Greek simply negates the location where the name was already established.
